requirements.summary: Create a new frontend page at route '/admin/add-job-role' that allows admins to add new job roles using the existing JobRoleForm component
acceptanceCriteria: New route '/admin/add-job-role' is accessible from the admin navigation
Page uses the existing JobRoleForm component in create mode
Page is protected with AdminGuard component
Successful job role creation redirects to the admin panel
Page has appropriate header and layout consistent with existing admin pages

file_operations.description: Create a new page component for adding job roles. The page must use the AdminGuard component to protect access, render a header consistent with AdminPanel.tsx styling, include the existing JobRoleForm component in create mode (no initialData prop), and handle successful creation by navigating to '/admin' using the router. Use the authorization component to ensure only admins can access this page.

requirements.summary: Add a navigation link or button in the AdminPanel page that directs users to the new job role creation page
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation element is clearly labeled (e.g., 'Add New Job Role' or 'Create Job Role')
Link/button is visually prominent and easy to find

file_operations.description: Add a prominent button or link element labeled 'Add New Job Role' near the top of the admin panel page. Use React Router's Link or navigate function to direct users to '/admin/add-job-role' when clicked. Position the button consistently with the existing admin panel layout and styling (e.g., next to the page header or above the job roles list).

requirements.summary: Update the App.tsx routing configuration to include the new job role creation page route
acceptanceCriteria: Route is properly registered in the router configuration
Route follows existing admin route patterns
Route is accessible only when authenticated and authorized as admin

file_operations.description: Register a new route for '/admin/add-job-role' in the router configuration. Follow the existing pattern used for the '/admin' route, ensuring the new route imports and renders the AddJobRolePage component. The route protection is handled by the AdminGuard component within AddJobRolePage itself, so no additional route-level guards are needed beyond what already exists for admin routes.
